## Installing Zeta Board

Android may show **"Google Play Protect – App scan recommended"** when you install. This is normal for any app that does not come from the Play Store: Google simply has not scanned this APK before. It does not mean the app is harmful.

1. Tap **Scan app**. Google checks the app and then lets you install it. (Or open **More details** and choose **Install without scanning**.)
2. Tap **Install**, then open Zeta Board -> **Enable** -> **Select**.
3. If your phone blocks the install, allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager when it asks.

The same message can appear again on each update. Tap **Scan app** again.
